articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Ve vakuu voda při nízké teplotě vře i mrzne zároveň. Objevili nové magické číslo protonů: 14. Největší soubor dat o supernovách naznačuje, že temná energie může v čase slábnout. Původ černých děr se projevuje v jejich rotaci, zjistila analýza gravitačních vln.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Kdyby objekt 3I/ATLAS byl mimozemskou sondou…

articles.author: Redakce
articles.description: Dala by se strunová teorie namísto potvrzení vyvrátit – falzifikovat? Interakce Higgsových bosonů by mohly ukazovat na novou fyziku – ale zatím neukázaly. Kam zmizela antihmota? Objevili narušení symetrie CP u baryonů. Nová technika umožňuje měřit s vysokou přesností teplotu hvězdy.
articles.title: Týden na ScienceMag.cz: Úpadek vědy a konec civilizací

articles.author: Reklama
articles.description: Nový školní rok je za dveřmi, tak neváhejte a kupte Windows 11 CDkey jen za €20.00 nebo Windows 11 Home Professional od Goodoffer24.com a budete připraveni s novým operačním systémem na nové úkoly! Můžete zde také koupit aplikace Office nebo hry.
articles.title: Zpátky do školy: Pořiďte si Windows 11 jen od €20.00!

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: EU chce (pořád) skenovat soukromé zprávy a fotografie. Návrh "Chat Control" by nařídil skenování všech soukromých digitálních komunikací, včetně šifrovaných zpráv a fotografií.
articles.title: EU chce (pořád) skenovat soukromé zprávy a fotografie

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byly publikovány fotografie a všechny videozáznamy z Python konference  PyCon US 2025 proběhlé v květnu.
articles.title: Videozáznamy z konference PyCon US 2025

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Společnost xAI a sociální síť X amerického miliardáře Elona Muska zažalovaly firmy Apple a OpenAI. Viní je z nezákonné konspirace s cílem potlačit konkurenci v oblasti umělé inteligence (AI).
articles.title: Muskovy firmy žalují Apple a OpenAI kvůli údajnému potlačování konkurence

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Byla vydána nová verze 9.16 z Debianu vycházející linuxové distribuce DietPi pro (nejenom) jednodeskové počítače. Přehled novinek v poznámkách k vydání.
articles.title: DietPi 9.16

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Americká vláda se po převzetí zhruba desetiprocentního podílu ve výrobci čipů Intel chystá na další investice do vybraných firem. Na sociální síti Truth Social to napsal prezident Donald Trump. Jeho ekonomický poradce Kevin Hassett v rozhovoru v televizi CNBC řekl, že nemusí jít pouze o firmy z technologického sektoru, ale i z jiných odvětví.
articles.title: Trump: Po převzetí podílu v Intelu se vláda zaměří na další podobné transakce

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: V Amsterdamu probíhá Open Source Summit Europe. Organizace Linux Foundation představuje novinky. Pod svá křídla převzala open source dokumentovou databázi DocumentDB.
articles.title: Open Source Summit Europe

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Přesně před 34 lety, 25. srpna 1991, oznámil Linus Benedict Torvalds v diskusní skupině comp.os.minix, že vyvíjí (svobodný) operační systém (jako koníček, nebude tak velký a profesionální jako GNU) pro klony 386 (486), že začal v dubnu a během několika měsíců by mohl mít něco použitelného.
articles.title: Linux slaví 34 let

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: 86Box, tj. emulátor retro počítačů založených na x86, byl vydán ve verzi 5.0. S integrovaným správcem VM. Na GitHubu jsou vedle zdrojových kódů ke stažení také připravené balíčky ve formátu AppImage.
articles.title: 86Box 5.0

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Vláda Spojených států získala desetiprocentní podíl v americkém výrobci čipů Intel. Oznámili to podle agentur americký prezident Donald Trump a ministr obchodu Howard Lutnick. Společnost Intel uvedla, že výměnou za desetiprocentní podíl obdrží státní dotace v hodnotě 8,9 miliardy dolarů (zhruba 186 miliard Kč). Částka podle Intelu zahrnuje dříve přislíbené subvence 5,7 miliardy dolarů z programu CHIPS na podporu výroby čipů v USA, které dosud vláda nevyplatila. Její součástí jsou také dotace v hodnotě 3,2 miliardy dolarů přidělené firmě v rámci program Secure Enclave, jehož cílem je zajistit spolehlivé dodávky čipů pro obranu USA.
articles.title: Americká vláda získala 10% podíl v Intelu

articles.author: Ladislav Hagara
articles.description: Organizace Apache Software Foundation (ASF) vydala verzi 27 integrovaného vývojového prostředí a vývojové platformy napsané v Javě NetBeans (Wikipedie). Přehled novinek na GitHubu. Instalovat lze také ze Snapcraftu a Flathubu.
articles.title: Apache NetBeans 27

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: Earlier this month I ran some benchmarks of Mesa's Rusticl OpenCL driver against AMD ROCm on Strix Halo. Those benchmarks caught many by surprise with how well that Rust-based open-source OpenCL driver was working on AMD GPUs for being a generic OpenCL implementation built atop Mesa's Gallium3D. For those curious about the potential of Rusticl on the Intel graphics side, here are some Battlemage benchmarks for Rusticl up against Intel's official Compute Runtime driver stack.
articles.title: Rusticl vs. Intel Compute Runtime Performance For OpenCL On Battlemage

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: While the Framework 13 was upgraded earlier this year with a motherboard upgrade for the AMD Ryzen AI 300 series "Strix Point", the larger Framework 16 has been stuck in the Zen 4 era. But today Framework announced a new upgrade path for this 16-inch modular laptop for the Ryzen AI 300 series as well as NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 discrete graphics...
articles.title: Framework Laptop 16 Upgrade Announced With Ryzen AI 300 Series, GeForce RTX 5070

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: LLVM 21.1 is out today as the first stable version of the LLVM 21 compiler stack. This half-year stable release to the open-source LLVM compiler software brings new hardware support, new language features, and a lot of other enhancements throughout this massive and widely-used codebase...
articles.title: LLVM 21.1 Released With AMD GFX1250 Target, Improved RISC-V, New C/C++ Features

articles.author: Michael Larabel
articles.description: While the ATI Radeon 9000 / X300 / X500 / X600 series "R300" GPU support has long been unmaintained on the Microsoft Windows driver side, thanks to the open-source community the Linux driver support keeps going for the old ATI R300 GPUs with that driver also supporting the X700 / X800 "R400" and X1000 "R500" series graphics cards too. Two more OpenGL extensions are now wired up for the old R300 Gallium3D driver within Mesa...
articles.title: Open-Source R300 Driver Adds New OpenGL Extensions For Two Decade Old Radeon GPUs

The Pokémon Company published a teaser today about the "mega matchup of the millennium" featuring Machamp versus Hawlucha. The #PokemonLegendsZA hashtag in the Instagram post indicates that a video will premiere on YouTube on Aug. 28 at 8am CT to reveal how it's connected to the upcoming game.


Hawlucha being featured in this post with "mega" in the description is no surprise to Pokémon fans who love a good leak. It is among the 25 Pokémon that a 4chan leaker reported would get a Mega evolution in Legends: Z-A when it releases on Oct. 16 on the Switch and Switch 2. This teaser revealing Hawlucha fighting Machamp in an upcoming video tied to the game is making a lot of players, including me, believe that the star of the Aug. 28 video will be Mega Hawlucha.




"Mega Hawlucha, please be goated," an excited fan wrote in the IG post's comments. "The official tweet refers to it as a 'mega matchup.' Very subtle," another player wrote on Reddit. "Either Machamp is winning and Hawlucha mega evolves to turn the tables, or the fight is even and they both mega evolve," another fan wrote, trying to predict the video script.


The possibility of a Mega Machamp made a second group of Pokémon fans really excited, even though the Pokémon isn't in any leaks released so far. You can choose your side: either Mega Machamp is coming, but nobody was able to leak it, or it will just be part of the plot for Hawlucha to Mega evolve. I'm more convinced of the second scenario.


Mega Victreebel and Mega Dragonite are the two other Mega evolutions confirmed for Pokémon Legends: Z-A so far. While Dragonite's transformation was revealed in a gameplay trailer, Victreebel got its own short animation that made me wish for a Pokémon horror game.


Aug. 28 should reveal if Mega Hawlucha is coming and if it looks like a fan's drawing.

Anyone who backed the original Hollow Knight Kickstarter over ten years ago should dust off their old inboxes, as Team Cherry is starting to roll out messages to you regarding Silksong.


Surveys are going out to players who backed the original game, asking them to pick their preferred codes for the upcoming release. The options are PC and Switch, despite Wii U being the original confirmed launch console all those years ago.




For those wondering why those who backed the original game are getting a code for free, well, it's pretty simple. Silksong was initially intended as a DLC for the first game. Still, it unexpectedly grew larger than anticipated, eventually becoming a spin-off and standalone game rather than a simple add-on DLC pack. 


It makes you wonder what else the team would have done had the original Kickstart gone beyond its 50,000 dollars in fundraising and unlocked additional Stretch Goals like the third playable character and even PS Vita support. In hindsight, it's amusing to see a project that only raised that much on Kickstarter achieve such success.


For anyone who did back the original Kickstarter but hasn't yet recieved a survey email to get their free game code, Team Cherry is asking players to contact backers@teamcherry.com.au mentioning the email address you used for the campaign for verification, as well as asking players to tell them their new email address, so they can get the survey sent out to you and confirm your identity. They also ask that people wait 48 hours before contacting them, though.


For anyone who didn't back the original Kickstarter, don't panic. No one is getting access to the game early. Not even the press are getting any form of early access (apparently), so everyone will be able to log in and experience the game on multiple systems come Sept. 4, when the game finally releases worldwide.


You know, unless Team Cherry decides to delay it for the memes.

The Bazaar's full launch has been mostly stable in the first couple of weeks, but players have encountered the Access: Request Timed Out error when trying to start a session.


The Bazaar always requires a persistent network connection for the modes to work. Naturally, problems related to network connectivity could, and will, arise from your end, creating different problems. The Access: Request Timed Out error is quite common if you played the game in the beta. However, there are a few easy tricks and tips to solve the problem if you run into it.


The Bazaar Access: Request Timed Out fixes


The Access: Request Timed Out error happens when you can't establish a smooth server connection. This can sometimes occur from your end, so you must ensure your internet connection works smoothly.




If that's taken care of, here are a few more things to try.



Restarting the game might not solve many problems with The Bazaar, but it can usually take care of the Access: Request Timed Out error. This is my go-to solution whenever I can't connect with the servers despite having a functioning internet connection.


Disable VPN if you're having problems with server connections. The game servers won't work if you're connected to a working VPN connection. So turning off any VPN/proxy hiders is mandatory if you want to enjoy the game.


Seems obvious, but the servers can be down occasionally due to updates. The game's official X account is the best place to track such events. You can also use other social media sources, like the game's subreddit, to stay on top of any routine maintenance.



A missing file or two can also cause problems when trying to connect to the servers. If you bought the game and downloaded the files on Steam, you can perform an Integrity Check. This will automatically locate and re-download any missing files vital to the game client's normal functioning.


The post How to fix the Access: Request Timed Out error in The Bazaar appeared first on Destructoid.

In light of increasing pressure on free speech in the UK, new site blocking powers under the Online Safety Act are a cause for concern. The UK may need a Pirate Bay-style poster boy to justify blocking of non-pirate sites, just as the Pirate Bay was used to justify pirate site blocking 15 years ago. After being threatened by Ofcom, the infamous 4chan appeared to swallow the bait this week. A question: who has who on the hook?
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Is 4chan the Perfect ‘Pirate Bay’ Poster Child to Justify Wider UK Site-Blocking?

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A new edition of the UK's Online Copyright Infringement Tracker has landed after taking a year off. The headline figure indicates a small decrease in the overall piracy rate, down from 32% in 2022 to 29% in 2024. In the movies, music and live sports categories, pirate consumption increased in 2024, with live sports increasing to a new high at the same time as legal subscriptions fall.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: UK Live Sports Piracy Sets New Record, Movie Piracy Returns to 2019 Peak

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Lithuania's broadcasting regulator (LRTK) challenges the accuracy of data reported by piracy tracking firm MUSO, which is the main input for key EUIPO reports. Citing flaws such as the inclusion of legal sites and an inability to track VPN or IPTV use, LRTK argues that its country is being unfairly portrayed as a piracy leader. In response, MUSO says the LRTK's statements are themselves misleading and the company demands a correction.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Lithuanian Regulator Clashes With Data Firm Over “Misleading” Piracy Stats

This brazen stance didn't go unnoticed by rights holders. This week, Argentinian authorities arrested the alleged operator, Alejo Leonel Warles, who now faces a criminal prosecution. His family is reportedly backing a fundraiser to aid a "David vs. Goliath" defense.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Alleged Pirate Site Operator Arrested, Family Crowdfunds “David vs. Goliath” Defense

Soon after GitHub complied with the DMCA notice, the tool's developer relaunched the project as 'EeveeSpotifyReborn', offering the same functionality but with a legal twist.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Spotify Takes Down EeveeSpotify; ‘Reborn’ Version Immediately Surfaces

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Two men said to be the operators of SmoothStreams, a pirate IPTV service shut down by entertainment companies over three years ago, have been imprisoned in Canada. Marshall Macciacchera and his father Antonio were both found guilty of contempt and sentenced to an initial term of six months. Marshall's sentence will continue until he complies with a court order to hand over financial information and a laptop password, among other things.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Two Alleged Pirate IPTV Operators Sent to Prison For Contempt of Court

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
German publisher Axel Springer, owner of brands including Bild and Die Welt, has been given another opportunity to have ad blocking outlawed on copyright grounds. After a series of defeats in its years-long legal action against the makers of Adblock Plus, the publisher appealed to the Federal Court of Justice. Germany's top court has now overturned a 2023 ruling by the Higher Regional Court of Hamburg, referring the case back for reconsideration of the core issues.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ‘Ad Blocking is Not Piracy’ Decision Overturned By Top German Court

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit has confirmed that copyright holders can't use a "DMCA subpoena shortcut" to identify internet subscribers suspected of copyright infringement. The Court sides with ISP Cox Communications, which intervened in the matter. The ruling blocks a legal tactic filmmakers have used to bypass the traditional, more expensive "John Doe" lawsuits. At the same time, it's also bad news for the MPA and RIAA.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Court of Appeals: DMCA Subpoena Shortcut to Unmask Pirates Remains Closed

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:

To encourage that important step, the BeStreamWise campaign focuses on the dangers of piracy; malware, credit card fraud, the risk of 'letting criminals in'. Through use of a particular model, the campaign hopes to achieve "the Holy Grail of behavioral change."
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Sky’s Piracy=Malware Campaign Aims For ‘Holy Grail’ of Behavioral Change

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Site-blocking orders are usually binary;  a court issues an order for a domain to be blocked, or it does not. In Belgium, things work differently. After we reported on a court order that compelled ISPs to block access to the Internet Archive's Open Library, a follow-up implementation order decided otherwise. Rightsholders, the authorities, and the Archive are now discussing how to move forward.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Why a Court Order to Block Internet Archive’s Open Library Was Put On Hold

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Last month Cloudflare began blocking pirate site domains already subject to blocking orders obtained years ago by Hollywood studios at the High Court in London. With no public announcement from any of the parties and no official information to accurately determine the scale, our estimate of a couple of hundred sites/domains was deliberately low. New information indicates one thousand domains is more realistic, but we can't rule out double that amount either.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: New Cloudflare Pirate Site Blocking May Already Involve Thousands of Domains

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:

The organization behind Spain’s top football league released a new anti-piracy campaign warning that if "you get pirated football," cybercriminals "get you". An ominous video suggests that pirate services enable criminals to drain bank accounts and steal viewers' identities.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: LaLiga Warns “You Get Pirated Football, They Get You”

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Launched in July 2023, Yubin Archive's popularity stemmed from its mission to "eliminate educational inequality" by providing copies of educational material to less well-off students in South Korea. Operating via Telegram, Yubin Archive had grown to over 330,000 members when its operator was arrested on Tuesday. The Ministry of Culture and Sport says others involved will be tracked down and given lessons in copyright law.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Library Operator Arrested, Study Canceled For 330K Members

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Sky Sports chief Jonathan Licht has added momentum to what some believe is the beginning of the end for football's 3pm 'blackout'. Speaking at Sky's Premier League launch, Licht said "it's a conversation that's coming" while effectively admitting that the restriction fuels piracy. It actually does something far worse; it provides unrivaled justification for piracy based on logic and common sense.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Sky Chief Admits 3pm TV Blackout Fuels Piracy; Or Even Justifies It, Pirates Insist

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Just weeks before its world premiere at the Venice Film Festival, Julian Schnabel's star-studded film 'In the Hand of Dante' has suffered a major setback after a high-quality screener copy leaked online. The leak is not an isolated incident as copies of other unreleased movies have also appeared online, some of which also have an Italian connection. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Unreleased Movie Screeners Leak Online, Including Star-Studded ‘In the Hand of Dante’

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A California man has been ordered to pay $15 million in damages for operating the pirate IPTV service 'Outer Limits'. After the defendant failed to respond to a lawsuit brought by a coalition of Hollywood studios, Netflix, and Amazon, a district court judge in California awarded the maximum statutory damages for willful copyright infringement.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Netflix, Amazon & Hollywood Win $15M Judgment Against U.S. Pirate IPTV Operator

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (Alikhan)
articles.description:
After many years of development, games made with World Builder are ready for testing. The World Builder creation system was released for the original Macintosh and was extremely popular among developers. As such, we're announcing that over 160 games built on the engine are ready for public testing in ScummVM.
Notable games made with World Builder include:
Ray's Maze. The game follows Frank Farley, a part-time adventurer, who finds himself in a Maze full of dangerous monsters and deadly traps. The objective of the game is to solve puzzles and escape the maze.
Radical Castle. You are given the role of a squire, who must bring back the stolen "Oracle" to the King to escape a fatal punishment.
Enchanced Scepters. The first game created using World Builder, and one of the few commercial games made with it. The player must find fire, earth, air, and water scepters and bring them back to the castle.
Most games made with WAGE are either freeware or shareware, and for your convenience we've collected all titles with these types into one big downloadable archive. So grab it from our game downloads page, get yourself a daily development build, and start your journey. As always, if you happen to have any issues, please submit the bug reports to our issue tracker. Lastly, contact us if you have some other unrecognised games or a new demo.
>
articles.title: Announcing support for World Builder-based games

articles.description:
USN-7648-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in PHP. This update
provides the corresponding updates for Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu
18.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 20.04 LTS.

Original advisory details:

 It was discovered that PHP incorrectly handled certain hostnames containing
 null characters. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to bypass
 certain hostname validation checks. (CVE-2025-1220)

 It was discovered that PHP incorrectly handled the pgsql and pdo_pgsql
 escaping functions. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
 cause PHP to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2025-1735)

 It was discovered that PHP incorrectly handled parsing certain XML data in
 SOAP extensions. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause
 PHP to crash, resulting in a denial of service. (CVE-2025-6491)
articles.title: USN-7648-2: PHP vulnerabilities
